Maya (CS Ops): Heads-up: product asked us to tighten trial healthscore decay from 90d -> 45d to surface churn risk earlier. Need ops + data to confirm playbook consequences before we flip.
Ethan (Data Eng): Quick thought: that will increase 'at-risk' population. I'll run an estimate by cohort. Do we only apply to trial_orgs (acct.type='trial')?
Maya (CS Ops): yes, trials only. Also exclude accounts with recent NPS >=4 in last 30d.
Rashmi (CSM): If the population grows too much, we'll drown CSMs with false positives. Can we prioritize by usage drop (>40%) AND decay window?
Zoe (Product): Prioritization makes sense. Proposed rule: set healthscore decay to 45d for trials, but auto-prioritize playbook alerts if 7d active usage < 60% of baseline.
Ethan (Data Eng): I'll run this SQL to estimate delta (trial cohort only):
Ethan (Data Eng): ```sql
WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.id, a.region, h.last_active, h.score, h.window_days
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN health_history h ON h.account_id = a.id
  WHERE a.type = 'trial'
),
decay45 AS (
  SELECT id FROM base WHERE last_active < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '45 days'
),
decay90 AS (
  SELECT id FROM base WHERE last_active < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM decay45) AS affected_45,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM decay90) AS affected_90,
  ((SELECT count(*) FROM decay45) - (SELECT count(*) FROM decay90)) AS delta
;
```
Rashmi (CSM): Can you scope to NA pilot first (tag=na-pilot)? We only want to test on 300 accounts.
Ethan (Data Eng): Scoped run results: affected_45 = 82, affected_90 = 47, delta = 35 (NA pilot). Global delta = +820 accounts.
Maya (CS Ops): Oof. +820 globally is non-trivial. What are top signals for the delta group?
Ethan (Data Eng): Top signals among the +820: low-active-users (62%), billing-not-signed (18%), product-setup-incomplete (12%), other (8%).
Zoe (Product): That suggests many are pre-sales or not setup. We should add an extra filter to the automated playbook: require product_setup_complete = true OR usage_drop > 40%. That will remove pre-sales noise.
Rashmi (CSM): Agree. Also exclude accounts with 'trial_owner' = 'partner_onboarding' (those are partner-managed).
Maya (CS Ops): Action plan draft:
- Ethan: run candidate query with filters (setup_complete OR usage_drop>40%) + na-pilot scope -> due Tue 10am
- Ethan: produce a sample CSV (top 50 impacted accounts) and include reason flags -> due Tue 10am
- Zoe: update playbook prioritization rules in staging -> due Tue EOD
- Rashmi: validate with CSMs on what auto-actions are OK (email only vs. task creation) -> due Wed noon
- Maya: prepare comms + dashboard widget for dry-run -> due Wed noon
OpsBot: Note: feature-flag "health-decay-45-trials" created (no users). Use /feature enable <org> to test.
Ethan (Data Eng): Candidate filtered SQL (will run now):
Ethan (Data Eng): ```sql
SELECT a.id, a.name, a.region, u.usage_last_7d, p.setup_complete, b.billing_signed
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN usage_summary u ON u.account_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN product_setup p ON p.account_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN billing b ON b.account_id = a.id
WHERE a.type = 'trial'
  AND a.tag = 'na-pilot'
  AND (a.last_active < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '45 days')
  AND (p.setup_complete = TRUE OR u.usage_last_7d < (u.usage_baseline * 0.6))
  AND b.billing_signed = FALSE
  AND a.trial_owner != 'partner_onboarding';
```
Ethan (Data Eng): Sample CSV (top 3 rows):
Ethan (Data Eng): ```csv
id,name,region,usage_last_7d,setup_complete,reason_flag
acct_9823,Acme Labs,NA,2,false,product_setup_incomplete
acct_6711,Greenfield Co,NA,1,false,low_usage
acct_4490,Bluebird Apps,NA,0,false,prebilling_no_contract
```
Rashmi (CSM): These look actionable. If playbook only opens a low-priority task for first touch and escalates on no response in 7 days, CSMs should manage.
Zoe (Product): We'll implement low-priority auto-task + escalation after 7d. Also add feature flag gating.
Maya (CS Ops): Final check: queue/backfill risk? If we flip flags global, will we create 800+ tasks at once. Liam (SRE) is out today; can someone confirm rate-limit for task creation?
Ethan (Data Eng): We can stagger backfill in batches of 100 accounts / 30 minutes. I'll include batching in the backfill job.
OpsBot: Reminder: scheduled job runner will respect feature flag rollout windows.
Maya (CS Ops): Good. Let's run NA pilot dry-run with flag enabled tomorrow, produce dashboard numbers, then decide on global rollout with the added filters. Reopen thread with results. :rocket:
